messages.text:
Good news: the instalments shouldn't complicate anything. Instalments of one payment count as a single payment record, and your order has exactly one valid payment (refund-policy/v2/payment).

- The shop's records show the monitor stand was received back (refund-policy/v2/return).
- It's within the refund window, which ends 2026-11-28 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).
- The refund would be 69.90 BRL, which is what you paid for the unit. It goes to the original payment only (refund-policy/v2/amount, refund-policy/v2/payment).

The next steps are these. I create a proposal and you confirm it with the button on the proposal card. Then a staff member approves it (refund-policy/v2/approval). The shop gives no date for when money appears on your card (refund-policy/v2/payout).

Would you like me to create the refund proposal now?
